channel.title: Capital goods & infra · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Capital goods & infra in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+2.4).

item.title: [+1] US trade deal awaits tariff clarity; India-EU FTA seen boosting FDI
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 22 reports from Bloomberg.com, Reuters, The Hindu and 16 more. Related: “India's NALCO, Russia's Rusal sign pact to study scandium recovery from red mud”. Ongoing: also reported on 5 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Trump Announces ‘Landmark’ Trade Deal With Philippines, But Manila Says Nothing Signed
item.description:
Signal: easing global trade barriers (global). 2 reports from Outlook India. Related: “CPI(M) Leader Sivankutty Opposes Thiruvananthapuram-Ahmedabad Twin City Pact”. Turn: earlier readings (13 Nov) pointed the other way.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — World trade recovers

Why it matters: Trade truces between major economies support world trade and demand for Indian exports.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] India GDP Grows 7.8% as Investment Spending Picks Up
item.description:
Signal: stronger Indian growth data (India). 2 reports from Equitypandit, Rediff MoneyWiz. Related: “India's Electronic Exports Jump 44% in Apr-Sep; Smartphones Up 35%”. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Orders and capex firm

Why it matters: Better activity data points to firmer demand, orders and credit growth, supporting earnings across cyclical sectors.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
